article.title: Duties, of seller and buyer.
article.content: It is the duty to the seller to deliver the goods and of the buyer to accept and pay for them, in accordance with the terms of the contract of sale.
article.html:
31Duties, of seller and buyer.

Section 31 · Chapter IV · page 9 of the Act

It is the duty to the seller to deliver the goods and of the buyer to accept and pay for them, in accordance with the terms of the contract of sale.
